front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FRONT reference image for image-to-3D generation of the existing Threadbound enemy Bellstriker.
Input image: supplied existing game model is the identity/design reference, not a composition reference. Preserve its distinctive crustacean/mantis-shrimp design, NOT a human or humanoid robot.
Create ONE full-body, centered, straight-on FRONT orthographic character reference on plain very light neutral gray. Clean polished stylized 3D model rendering with broad readable surfaces and restrained texture, soft even studio lighting, no hard cast shadows, no floor or props, no lettering, no borders.
Identity: deep navy/cobalt overlapping chitin plates with thin worn gold edges, ivory undersides and ivory large claw panels, restrained coral-red joint accents, small crustacean head with two eyes, long paired swept antennae with red tips, broad layered abdomen tapering to a scalloped tail fan. Exactly TWO enormous closed armored boxing clubs, each connected to one clearly articulated two-segment arm. Exactly EIGHT small walking legs, four on each side.
Pose: relaxed symmetrical nonhuman A-pose for rigging. Present the creature's underside/front to camera in a gently raised swimming/guard-neutral posture, long abdomen and tail descending behind the small legs so the whole creature fits visibly on the canvas. Do not invent a humanoid chest, pelvis, hands, feet, or upright human proportions. Extend the two big arms widely outward and slightly downward with gentle elbow bends, clubs separated from body and legs by generous empty background. Both shoulder, elbow, wrist connections clearly visible. Spread the four small legs on EACH side like a gently descending fan, separated with background gaps, knees softly bent, each small pointed foot individually readable, no touching/crossing/fused limbs. Antennae curve up/out with gaps, not crossing arms. Tail fan uncurled and visible below body. This is a neutral anatomical generation pose, not a boxing action pose. Match bilateral armor and claw shapes. Keep full antennae, clubs, feet, and tail within frame with 10% padding. Highly legible clean silhouette. Preserve the reference's animal identity and navy/gold/ivory/coral palette, but clean up the awkward thin blue prototype connection rods into anatomically plausible short armored arm segments. No new ornament, weapons, clothes, magical effects, or scenery.
front_correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Bellstriker FRONT image for a 3D modeling reference. Keep the entire existing design, camera, palette, two enormous armored closed clubs, four long antennae, face, abdomen, and neutral spread-arm pose unchanged. Make ONE anatomical correction: it currently has only THREE small walking legs per side. It must have exactly FOUR small walking legs per side, EIGHT small walking legs total, in addition to the two big club arms. Add a fourth matched pair below the existing lowest pair, attached along the lower abdomen above the tail fan. Space all four leg pairs along the abdomen so their individual segmented shins and pointed feet have generous clear background gaps, and are easy to count. Extend abdomen very slightly only if necessary for clean spacing. Do not add legs to the clubs or head. Retain full body framing and plain light gray background, soft even light, no text. Scale the whole creature down a little to give all antenna tips and clubs at least 6% clear border. This must still be the same Bellstriker; no other redesign.
back:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: BACK orthographic image-to-3D reference, companion to the provided FRONT image of Bellstriker.
The supplied image is the exact approved-for-this-reference-pair front design and framing to match, not a request for another front view.
Create ONE image showing this SAME creature from directly BEHIND, a 180-degree camera orbit around its vertical axis, without changing its pose. Keep identical canvas aspect ratio, scale, center position, antenna spread, arm angles, claw sizes, eight small leg lengths and spacing, body length, tail-fan outline, and neutral light gray background. Full body with same margin. Straight-on rear orthographic projection. No text or extra views.
Important anatomy: this is a nonhuman armored mantis shrimp creature, not a man in armor. Exactly two large closed boxing clubs on articulated arms spread down/out; exactly FOUR small walking legs on EACH SIDE, eight total, spaced like the front reference with visible gaps. Four long navy/gold/coral-red antennae arch out/up. The long plated abdomen descends to the same scalloped red/ivory/navy fan. All knees, elbows and wrists stay at matching height. No added legs, weapons, ornaments or clothes.
REAR surfaces: show back of the small head, no face or eyes looking at viewer; broad dorsal carapace and overlapping cobalt/navy shell plates edged in worn gold running down the back and abdomen. Preserve slender tapered abdomen and broad upper shell proportions. The ivory ventral belly shown in the front must now be hidden, not painted on the back. Show the backs of the same large clubs: predominantly navy armored overlapping plates and gold edges, some ivory/coral near side rims, exactly same external club outlines and lengths. Small legs and antennae viewed from behind, with red flexible joints and dark pointed feet. Tail fan reverse retains corresponding five main scalloped lobes, gold-edged navy surfaces and restrained ivory/red ends. The model remains perfectly bilaterally coherent.
Style: polished stylized 3D model reference render, clean readable surfaces, even neutral studio lighting, restrained texture, no dramatic shadows, no floor, no scenery. This is the rear view of the supplied design, not a redesign.
